dedupe_keys.name: contactless partial discharge power line signals

description: The VSB partial-discharge research team publishes contactless antenna signals from medium-voltage overhead lines with XLPE-covered conductors. The collection describes nearly three years of hourly acquisition from nine stations in Czechia and Slovakia. Each observation is a 20 ms signal. It separates manually checked examples from annotations inferred through a galvanic-contact monitoring method. NumPy signal arrays are packaged in compressed archives, with CSV metadata; inspected components are free under CC0. The data can calibrate fault-detection or asset-condition components used alongside network simulations with platform-opendss. A caveat is that inferred annotations are not equivalent to expert-confirmed faults, and the short sampled signals do not form continuous recordings. The complete station and date coverage should be checked before estimating failure rates. No signal archive was downloaded, and this review did not verify every component or reproduce detection accuracy.
